questions.question: Your background includes civil engineering and construction projects involving electrical work. What hands-on experience do you have performing electrical testing, using test instruments, or troubleshooting electrical equipment?

Describe your work on the Iraqi Ministry of Electricity project. How did you coordinate civil work, steel assembly, and the 132 kVA tower foundations while meeting project safety and quality requirements?

This role requires reading schematics, block diagrams, functional diagrams, and wire lists. What types of electrical or construction drawings have you interpreted, and how have you used them to guide field work?
Tell us about a time you identified a field issue or nonconformance during construction. How did you document it, communicate it to stakeholders, and help drive resolution?
What experience do you have preparing daily reports, method statements, quality-control reports, as-built drawings, or other technical documentation? How did you ensure their accuracy?
Describe your experience overseeing subcontractors and site activities. How did you verify that work was completed according to drawings, specifications, schedule, and safety requirements?

This position involves troubleshooting manufacturing and component problems down to the LRU level. Walk us through your general approach to isolating the source of a technical problem when multiple systems or contractors may be involved.
What safety practices have you followed while working around construction sites, electrical infrastructure, steel erection, heavy equipment, or energized systems?

The role may require installation, termination, and repair of electrical panels and components. What exposure have you had to electrical installation work, and what would you do before beginning work on an unfamiliar electrical system?

This is a heavy industrial rail-vehicle environment that may require shift work, overtime, outdoor work, and lifting up to 50 pounds. Are you prepared for these working conditions, and what experience do you have working in similar field environments?
